title: Nonradial linear stability of liquid Lane-Emden stars
summary: The classical model of a star is the Lane-Emden star with dynamics governed by the Euler-Poisson equations. We consider the case of a liquid star with a "stiffened gas" equation of state $p=ρ^γ-1$. We derive the full 3D linearised Euler-Poisson system around liquid Lane-Emden stars with no symmetry assumptions on the perturbations and show that the associated linear operator $\mathbf L$ is non-negative whenever the radial mode is non-negative. We show that $\mathbf L$ has an infinite-dimensional kernel each element of which corresponds to a linearly growing solution to the linearised system.…
